functionalCoverage.action: view a list of all GUC students and their current scheduling workflow status
functionalCoverage.sourceRules: The list includes Normal Students and Advising Students and shows full name, GUC email, student ID, student type, major, current semester, assigned Advisor when applicable, workflow status, blocking step and last update time. The status is calculated from completed workflow actions; Advisors do not manually overwrite it. Normal-student statuses include Schedule Assigned, Swap Request Open, Swap Completed, Swap Withdrawn and Swap Expired. Advising-student statuses include Not Started, Draft, Ready for Student Review, Change Request Pending, Pending Approval, Awaiting Payment Choice, Deferred to Next Installment, Ready to Process, Processed and Reopened.
functionalCoverage.implementationLevel: Local preview; baseline production route retained

functionalCoverage.action: view a student's current weekly schedule including course code, course name, lecture, tutorial and lab times and locations
functionalCoverage.sourceRules: A Normal Student may view only their own processed standard schedule. An Advising Student may view their own completed draft after an Advisor or Coordinator marks it Ready for Student Review, and may continue to view the final processed schedule. A completed draft has every required course and lecture, tutorial and lab slot assigned, has no blocking validation issue, and is not yet final. Incomplete drafts remain hidden from the student. Advisors and Coordinators may view an advising student's draft, review-ready or processed schedule, and Administrators have read-only access. The schedule is displayed as a weekly calendar and shows days off.
functionalCoverage.implementationLevel: Local preview; baseline production route retained

functionalCoverage.action: approve or reject an advising-student slot-change request and provide an optional response note
functionalCoverage.sourceRules: Approval selects the exact replacement slot. Revalidate capacity and timetable clashes, then update the completed schedule and both slot capacities atomically so the same final seat cannot be assigned twice. The schedule remains Ready for Student Review until all pending requests are resolved and it is processed.

An Advising Student may view only their own academic history. Advisors and Coordinators may view any advising student.

functionalCoverage.action: view an advising student's advising reason, system-calculated credit-hour allowance, schedule status and bachelor-project eligibility
functionalCoverage.sourceRules: Advising reasons are probation, more than two failed courses in a season, unattended courses, undeclared CS or DMET major, or transfer from another major/university. Standard allowances are 34 hours for semesters 3-4, 30 for semesters 5-6, 28 for semester 7, and 24 from semester 8 onward. On the GUC scale, probation is GPA 3.70 or above; probation students receive 25% less hours than normal student (any decimal points to be rounded up) hours and cannot receive an increase. Workflow status is calculated automatically from the student's draft, pending approvals, settlement decision and processing actions; it is not manually selected by an Advisor. Bachelor-project eligibility requires completion of all courses from semesters 1-6 and all English courses including RPW. A student with only one or two failed courses from semesters 1-6 remains eligible if all English courses including RPW are complete.
functionalCoverage.implementationLevel: Local preview; baseline production route retained

functionalCoverage.action: add the bachelor project to an eligible student's schedule and select whether it will be taken in Winter or Spring
functionalCoverage.sourceRules: A bachelor student may take up to four courses with the project: at most two core courses and two humanities. Humanities are German courses, Seminar, Introduction to Management and Project Management. These courses are treated as extra hours and follow the extra-hours approval and payment flow.
functionalCoverage.implementationLevel: Local preview; baseline production route retained

functionalCoverage.action: view an advising student's failed and unattended courses as mandatory-course candidates
functionalCoverage.sourceRules: Failed and unattended courses are mandatory unless an approved removal applies.
functionalCoverage.implementationLevel: Local preview; baseline production route retained

functionalCoverage.action: create an open draft schedule for an advising student
functionalCoverage.sourceRules: Display any submitted scheduling preferences while the draft is created. Preferences are optional and their absence does not block schedule creation.
functionalCoverage.implementationLevel: Local preview; baseline production route retained

functionalCoverage.action: select the mandatory courses to include in an advising student's schedule
functionalCoverage.sourceRules: Mandatory courses are selected before other courses and consume the student's available credit hours. If mandatory courses consume all allowed hours, no other course may be added without approved extra hours.
functionalCoverage.implementationLevel: Local preview; baseline production route retained

functionalCoverage.action: request the removal of a mandatory course and provide the reason
functionalCoverage.sourceRules: Valid cases include an incorrect mandatory designation due to first- or second-makeup eligibility, or deferral when the student completed more than 157 hours or would otherwise take restricted pairs of CS, Math or Physics courses in the same term. Students always receive a first makeup. A second makeup is available only when the student has one or two failed courses.

functionalCoverage.sourceRules: Processing finalizes the schedule. It is blocked while any slot-change request is Pending or while a required approval or payment choice remains unresolved. After processing, the student may view and download the final schedule but cannot submit a new pre-processing slot-change request.
